atoms.sound: Computer viruses work similarly to viruses in living things. They harm your computer.

atoms.a: How can viruses get onto your device?

atoms.text:
Viruses can get onto your device through spam mail. Your computer will often recognise these and automatically sort them into the spam folder of your email program.
Select the spam folder.

The virus is often hidden behind a download link.
Select where the link might be.

You can often tell whether it is spam mail or not from the sender’s email address. If it is an unknown address, that’s a sign that the email could be spam, so you should be especially careful.
Select the sender’s address.

instruction.text: Are these statements true or false?

atoms.a: I should always open and download attachments from unknown emails.

feedback.end: Viruses can get onto your devices through email attachments. You should always be careful about opening email attachments, especially when they’re from unknown senders.

atoms.a: When I want to download something from a website, I should always ask my legal guardian first.

feedback.end: You should always have a close look before you download any data to make sure it is safe and that there is no malicious software hidden in it.

atoms.a: An antivirus program can help protect my device from malicious software.

feedback.end: Antivirus programs check your device to find possible threats and remove them.
